Layouts

Kitchen sinks: single bowl, double bowl and undermount

A single bowl gives the most room for trays and large pots. A double bowl kitchen sink lets you wash in one side and rinse or drain in the other. A sink with a drainer keeps water off the bench.

An undermount kitchen sink is fixed below the benchtop for a clean edge. Many of the stainless steel sinks here are described as universal, so they can be fitted as topmount or undermount.

Pricing

Kitchen sink prices

27 sinks show their price on this site, from $209 to $1,250. Stainless steel sinks start at $209, and quartz sinks run from $374 to $1,250.

The other sinks in the Poseidon range show Enquire Now, and the team confirms the price for the size and colour you choose.

Materials

Stainless steel, quartz or fireclay

A stainless steel kitchen sink is the practical default. The priced stainless sinks are described as 304 stainless steel, and coloured versions are listed in black, gun metal and brushed gold. If you want a black kitchen sink, there are stainless, quartz and fireclay options.

Quartz sinks are a composite stone. If you are searching for a granite kitchen sink, they are the closest match on this range. Fireclay sinks have a glazed ceramic surface, in gloss white and matte black.

A farmhouse sink, also called a butler sink, has an exposed front that sits forward of the cabinets. There are quartz and fireclay farmhouse sinks on this page.

Sizes

Sink sizes from 240 to 1160 wide

Sinks on this page run from 240 mm to 1160 mm wide overall. The smallest are narrow single bowls. The largest are double bowl sinks with a drainer.

The size is in the product name or description, usually as overall width, depth and bowl depth. Match the overall width to your cabinet and the bowl depth to how you cook.

Availability

Sink availability and order times

Send the product name or code and the colour, and the team confirms what can be supplied and when. Have the sink on site before the benchtop is cut.

Mounting

Topmount or undermount: what your benchtop needs

Topmount, undermount or flushmount: which suits your benchtop?

TopmountUndermountFlushmount
How it sitsDrops in from above, with the rim on the benchFixed under the bench, with the stone edge exposedSet into a rebate so the rim is level with the bench
BenchtopAny, including laminateStone and solid surface tops onlyStone and solid surface tops
CleaningThe rim catches crumbsCrumbs wipe straight into the bowlNearly as easy as undermount
FittingThe simplest to fit and replaceNeeds a polished cut-out and strong fixingNeeds a precise rebate cut by the stonemason

A general comparison. Many sinks on this page can be fitted as topmount or undermount.

Whichever way it is fitted, the join between sink and bench is sealed. See colour matched silicone for the sealant.

Warranty

Sink warranty

Sinks carry their maker's warranty. Ask us for the warranty terms of the sink you choose, and keep the fitting details with your receipt.

Getting it

Pick-up and Sydney delivery

Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177. We are open Monday to Friday 7am to 5pm and Saturday 7am to 3pm. Sinks are boxed and easy to collect, or they can be delivered across Sydney metro with your tiles.

The range

Poseidon kitchen sinks

The sinks come from Poseidon and its KDK Home range: 70 stainless steel sinks, 37 quartz sinks and 26 fireclay sinks, including the Camden, Kensington, Greenwich, Chelsea and Bradley fireclay series.

The page also lists laundry tubs and cabinets, and sink accessories such as basket wastes. For the wider range, see kitchen sinks and mixers.

Care

Keeping a stainless sink scratch free

Stainless steel marks with use, and fine scratches blend into the grain over time. Use a soft cloth or sponge, clean along the grain, and rinse and dry the bowl after use.

A sink grid protects the base from pots and pans. Never use steel wool: it leaves particles that rust.

Kitchen sinks

Kitchen sink questions

What size kitchen sink do I need?

Start with the cabinet. The sink has to fit inside it, so a 600 mm cabinet usually takes a single bowl and a 900 mm cabinet takes a double bowl or a bowl with a drainer. Then match the bowl depth to your largest pots.

Is an undermount sink better than a topmount?

An undermount sink is easier to wipe into and looks cleaner, but it needs a stone or solid surface benchtop. A topmount sink suits any benchtop, including laminate, and is simpler to replace.

Do stainless steel sinks scratch?

Yes, every stainless steel sink picks up fine scratches with use. They blend into the grain over time. Cleaning along the grain and using a sink grid keeps them to a minimum.

How much is a kitchen sink?

The kitchen sinks with a price on this site run from $209 to $1,250, depending on the size and material. Other sinks show Enquire Now.

Does the sink come with a waste and strainer?

Often, yes. 53 sinks on this page state in their description that a waste is included or name the waste supplied. Check the description of the sink you choose.

Can I see kitchen sinks in the showroom?

Call (02) 8786 0288 before you visit and the team will tell you which sinks can be viewed at the showroom. Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177.
